import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem odd_iff_three_dvd_pow_add_one (b : ℕ) (hb : b % 3 = 2) (k : ℕ) : Odd k ↔ 3 ∣ b ^ k + 1 := by
  have hpow : ∀ n, b ^ n % 3 = if Odd n then 2 else 1 := by
    intro n
    induction' n with n ih
    · simp
    · rw [pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod, hb, ih]
      by_cases h : Odd n
      · have h_not : ¬ Odd (n + 1) := by
          obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := h
          intro ⟨k, hk⟩
          omega
        simp [h, h_not]
      · have h_even : n % 2 = 0 := by
          rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one n with h0 | h1
          · exact h0
          · exfalso; exact h ⟨n / 2, by omega⟩
        have h_odd : Odd (n + 1) := ⟨n / 2, by omega⟩
        simp [h, h_odd]
  rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
  have h_add : (b ^ k + 1) % 3 = (b ^ k % 3 + 1) % 3 := by rw [Nat.add_mod, Nat.one_mod]
  rw [h_add, hpow k]
  by_cases h : Odd k
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]
